simple.meaning: זָמַם (zâmam) is a Hebrew concept word meaning “to plan , usually in a bad sense.” BibleIQ follows how Scripture develops this idea across its occurrences.
simple.biblicalBackground: The concept appears 13 times across Genesis, Deuteronomy, Psalms, Proverbs, Jeremiah, and 2 more, beginning at Genesis 11:6. Its contexts include family.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to זָמַם (H2161).
simple.whyItMatters: Concept words shape biblical themes. BibleIQ keeps the concept grounded in actual verse evidence instead of starting with a later theological definition.
simple.summary: זָמַם (zâmam) / H2161 is traced through Genesis 11:6, Deuteronomy 19:19, Psalms 17:3, Psalms 31:14 as a generated source-based concept entry.

definitions.short: to plan , usually in a bad sense
definitions.usage: consider, devise, imagine, plot, purpose, think (evil).
definitions.full: H2161. zamam זָמַם verb consider, purpose, devise (Aramaic זְמַם in derived conjugations; compare Arabic speak, talk (rare); Aramaic is sonuit, resonavit , the noun is tinnitus, strepitus ) — only Qal Perfect זָמַם Deut 19:19 2 t.; זָמָ֑ם Lam 2:17 ; זָָֽמְמָה Prov 31:16 ; זַמּ֫וֺתָ 30:32 ; זַמֹּ֫תִי Jer 4:28 but also זָמַ֫מְתִּי Zech 8:14-15 , זַמֹּתִי Psa 17:3 either belongs here with irregular accent (see De), or is Infinitive after analogue of לה֞ e.g. חַנּוֺת compare 77:10 (Hi Ri); Che critical note reads זִמָּתִי ; זָמָ֑מוּ 31:14 ; Imperfect יָָֽזְמוּ Gen 11:6 (Ges § 67 , R. 11); on possible Infinitive זמֹּתִ֫י Psa 17:3 see above; Participle זֹמֵם 37:12 ; — 1 consider, fix thought upon , with accusative of concrete object שָׂדֶה Prov 31:16 . 2 purpose, devise: a. especially of Yahweh's purpose in punishment Jer 4:28 (absolute), 51:12 followed by עשׂה + accusative (|| מְזִמָּה ), Lam 2:17 (followed by אשׁר ) Zech 1:6 (with כאשׁר followed by infinitive), 8:14 ( id. ); of blessing only לְהֵיטִיב זָמַמְתִּי שַׁבְתִּי כֵּן 8:15 (opposed to 8:14 ). b. of evil purpose of wicked men יז ׳אשׁר לעשׂות Gen 11:6 ; Deut 19:19 (with כאשׁר + infinitive), Psa 31:14 (followed by infinitive); absolute Prov 30:32 (|| נבל ), Psa 17:3 have I (i.e. if I have) devised evil (so De); followed by לְ person (= against ) 37:12 . **the text of Prov 30:32 is questioned by Frankenb Toy and others; see on II. נבל , below.
